trips.name: The Canadian
trips.note: Pool train (CP - CN joint Montreal / Ottawa - Toronto service). The Canadian: on from Toronto as CP No. 19 to London, Windsor and Detroit. Leaves the CP for the CN at Dorval (Table 49 Note A). Westmount, Montreal West: stop to pick up passengers only. Danforth: stops on signal Fridays only to let off. The Ottawa section runs Ottawa - Smiths Falls - Brockville (Table 47, Pool 559). Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.

trips.name: Royal York
trips.note: Pool train (CP - CN joint Montreal / Ottawa - Toronto service). Royal York: from Detroit and Windsor as CP No. 38. Joins the CP at Dorval. Port Hope: stops on signal. The Ottawa section runs Brockville - Smiths Falls - Ottawa (Table 47, Pool 560). Shown in Pacific time: three hours earlier than the Eastern time printed.
